title: Tessellate Resource Preview
visibleText:
Accessibility Commitment Section preview
Accessibility commitments — WCAG 2.2 AA target
DESIGN TARGET
Keyboard First

Design goal: support Tab, Enter, Space and Escape for every core control; verify keyboard behavior in your integration.

DESIGN TARGET
Contrast Guardrails

Design goal: maintain WCAG AA contrast; test your final foreground and background combinations.

DESIGN TARGET
Reduced Motion

Design goal: honor prefers-reduced-motion and verify that essential interactions work without animation.
accessibilityScope: Host preview shell only; the isolated preview iframe is inspected separately for content and layout.
